_about: Prompts for whosedime-maker steps 1-5 and the state (build sessions S04, S05). Files are relative to this folder. Eval 3 was run once in S04 on Uber, evals 6 and 7 once in S05 on the same folder: files/01_uber/ holds their outputs (see README.md).

evals.prompt: nouvelle vidéo Whose Dime. propose-moi des sujets
evals.expected_output: Step 1, in the chat, no file: 3 topics in the form '[Brand] [free or cheap thing]: Who Pays?' (or 'Who Paid?'), each under 40 characters with its count; for each, the payer lead, the decision to check, a measured demand signal with source and date (docs/finance/marques.md, 2026-11-05, or a fresh API search with its date; never a view count from memory), and a risk line. Starts from the next undone topic of PLAN_ACTION § 3 (Uber first if no video exists). A 2-sentence recommendation, then ONE question ('Which one do we make?'), in French since Franco writes French. Then the self-critique and the grade question come after his choice, not in the same message.

evals.prompt: on fait Uber. lance la recherche et le fact check
evals.expected_output: Step 2 for 01_uber: 01_research.md (sources read in full with the date read; payer chain investors -> drivers -> taxi owners or a stated change; the dated decision with its people; three scenes each with a person, a place, a gesture and a sourced line; nuance; leads not used) and 02b_factcheck.md in the FACTCHECK_FORMAT (## Facts, ## People, ## Signature; fact texts written as the script will say them; 'verified' only for sources actually read, with a read date; blocked or unread sources marked [TO VERIFY]; Horan's 41% labelled as his estimate). Does not reuse tests/fixtures/whosedime/factcheck_clean.md. Runs 'checker.py fingerprint' and gives Franco the exact 'Signed: Franco, YYYY-MM-DD, sha256:...' line to paste. Pause 2: 5-line summary, Drive links, one question asking him to read and sign. No outline, no script.

evals.prompt: voici le fact check signé d'Uber. écris le plan puis le script
evals.expected_output: Checks the signature hash first (fingerprint matches). Step 3a: 02a_outline.md with the six beats of PLAN_ACTION § 2, word budgets, fact ids, people and scenes, three dollar steps each with payer, amount and fact id, total 2,000-2,250 words; Pause 3 (one question). After 'oui': 02_script.md with the headings '## Cold open', '## Setup', '## The decision', '## Follow the dollar' (three '### Step' parts), '## Consequences', '## Lesson and next', [^Fnn] tags, quotes word for word from the people block, a next-video phrase in the last 60 words; 02_script_voice.txt (same words, numbers and symbols spelled out, lexicon respellings, one sentence per line, blocks of 2-4 sentences); 02c_listen_20s.txt (about 50 words). Acceptance: 'python3 whosedime/common/checker.py all <folder>' exits 0 with at most 3 warnings, each warning explained. E1-E5 self-check with places, then Pause 4 asking Franco to listen to the 20 s sample. Reference run: files/01_uber/ (0 blocks, 1 warning, 2,087 words).

evals.prompt: reprends Uber, j'ai corrigé une date dans le fact check
evals.expected_output: Reads the folder; sees 02b_factcheck.md signed but 'checker.py fingerprint' gives a different hash than the Signed line (the voice check says 'registry changed since it was signed'). Does not edit the signature itself: shows what changed if it can (the line Franco edited), checks that the script still matches the registry ('checker.py script'), gives the new 'Signed: Franco, <date>, sha256:...' line and asks Franco, in one question, to re-read and sign again. Does not move on to the voice before the new signature.

evals.prompt: (on claude.ai, with the .skill archive only) le script d'Uber est validé, fais la version voix
evals.expected_output: Says in one line that the claude.ai archive has no checker: the signature hash and the voice check need Claude Code with the repo. Stops before the voice version; gives the opening message to continue in Claude Code. Does not produce an unchecked 02_script_voice.txt.

evals.prompt: le script d'Uber est validé à l'écoute. fais les scènes et les prompts
evals.expected_output: Reads 00_state.md and the folder; checks that 'checker.py all' exits 0 on script and voice. Step 4: 03_scenes.md with the table '| n | type | spoken text | visual | motion | on-screen text | chart |', 85-95 scenes: 50-55 image, 25-30 chart, 4-5 video (never two in a row), 1 title card 'WHO PAYS?' at the start of the setup, 6 chapter cards (the decision, the three dollar steps, consequences, lesson); the spoken text of the non-card scenes is 02_script.md word for word (no tags, no headings); every chart cites verified fact ids and only their numbers ('F07 · compare · ...'); image prompts in English in batches of 10 after a preamble, no real person named or drawn realistically, no exact logo, no text in images; one anim_NNN prompt per video scene. Acceptance: 'checker.py scenes' exits 0 (reference: 91 scenes, 0 blocks, 0 warnings). Then shows the preamble and every prompt in the chat, one code block each, names the chart and card scenes that have no prompt, writes the step 4 self-critique and log line (Franco's grade null until he has seen the images), and goes on to step 5 without a pause.

Step 5: 04_publication.md with '## Titles' (3 titles, each <= 40 characters, the plan's 'Uber Was Cheap. Who Paid?' first, a title holding a number cites its fact as [^Fnn]), '## Thumbnail' (3 variants with one idea each, 1-3 words or one number with its [^Fnn], the 'WHO PAYS?' badge, cartoon caricature only of a well-known executive and unnamed in the prompt, no exact logo), '## Description' (hook with registered names only, chapters 0:00 Cold open then one --:-- line per title and chapter card, next video, the channel promise), '## Sources' (sources read, with links), '## Notes' (recommended title with its count, thumbnail trio, three complete thumbnail prompts, chapters note, end screen and playlist, the before-publishing checklist). Acceptance: 'checker.py all' on the folder exits 0 (reference run: 0 blocks; 1 name-first warning on the script, 1 on the publication). Pause 5: three lines, the Drive link, the thumbnail prompts in code blocks, one question on title and thumbnails; then the critique line, 00_state.md and videos.md rewritten.

Reads WhoseDime/Memory/videos.md, then the 00_state.md of each video in progress, and lists the folder of each; answers in French, one line per video: folder, step reached, next action, who does it, date of the state; flags any disagreement between a state file and its folder and says the folder wins. Writes nothing unless a state is wrong (then rewrites it and says so). Tested in S05 with a fresh Haiku agent on a fake Drive tree (see README.md).
